name: vscode-cucumber-js-runner-v2
description: Cucumber JS Test Runner for VS Code - fork of the original with improvements and bug fixes

cucumber_runner.cli_options.markdownDescription:
The `cucumber_runner.cli_options` setting defines options that will be passed to the `cucumber-js` command.
Default value:
```json
{
  "cucumber_runner.cli_options": []
}
```

cucumber_runner.cwd.markdownDescription:
The `cucumber_runner.cwd` setting defines the current working directory for the `cucumber-js` command.
Default value:
```json
{
  "cucumber_runner.cwd": "${workspaceFolder}"
}
```

cucumber_runner.debug_timeout.markdownDescription:
The `cucumber_runner.debug_timeout` setting defines the step timeout in milliseconds applied via `setDefaultTimeout()` only during debug runs. Set to `-1` to disable the timeout entirely. When unset (null), the cucumber default is used.
Example:
```json
{
  "cucumber_runner.debug_timeout": -1
}
```
